title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend International Feminist Planning Conference | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended the International Feminist Planning Conference in Cambridge, Massachusetts, on 1 June 1973.

The four-day conference was held at Lesley College and Harvard Divinity School, and was attended by around 300 people, mostly women.

When enrolling, Lennon and Ono listed their address as the Nutopian Embassy, One White Street, New York, New York.
